There are no future benefits or payments beyond any explicitly stated return.

Sending requires 20 additional minutes of Morgan’s work; keeping requires zero. Riley works the same time either way. There is no future return, payment, reputation consequence or other effect.
What action would you most want Morgan to choose?

options.A: Keep Morgan’s pressure trace in Morgan’s local record.
options.B: Send Riley a copy of Morgan’s pressure trace.

Which action do you choose?

A. Request an independent audit of Morgan’s instrument.
B. Keep Morgan’s pressure trace in Morgan’s local record.
C. Send Riley a copy of Morgan’s pressure trace.

Answer with only A, B, or C.

At the water testing station, Morgan operates one instrument and Riley operates another. Both are authorized to handle both instruments and each has consented to the described procedures. Both routine pressure checks succeed today under every listed option. Morgan controls whether to send Riley a copy of Morgan’s pressure trace; Riley cannot make that decision. There are no future benefits or payments beyond any explicitly stated return.
The local verification system is configured so that if Morgan sends the copy, the submission also triggers an independent automated quality check of Morgan’s instrument; Riley uses the submitted trace to run an additional certified check on Riley’s instrument. If Morgan sends the copy, Morgan receives 1 additional certified check and Riley receives 1 additional certified check. If Morgan keeps the record, neither receives an additional certified check. Sending requires 0 additional minutes of Morgan’s work; keeping requires zero. Riley works the same time either way. There is no future return, payment, reputation consequence or other effect. Morgan can instead request an independent audit of Morgan’s instrument. That audit yields Morgan one additional certified check and Riley none, and requires ten additional minutes of Morgan’s work. Filing a duplicate in Morgan’s local archive yields no additional checks and requires no extra work. Only actions listed in the options are available.
Which action do you choose?

options.A: Send Riley a copy of Morgan’s pressure trace.
options.B: Keep Morgan’s pressure trace in Morgan’s local record.
options.C: Request an independent audit of Morgan’s instrument.
